<summary>
Task: Seismic P/S phase picking on 100 npz traces in /root/data/, output picks to /root/results.csv (file_name, phase, pick_idx). Pass: F1>=0.7 P, F1>=0.6 S with 0.1s tolerance (10 samples at dt=0.01).

Data (Turn 2): each npz has data (12000,3) float32, dt=0.01, channels e.g. "DPE,DPN,DPZ", amplitudes ~1e-14 (agent scales by 1e10). Extra fields: snr, p_weight, s_weight, distance_km, magnitude, start_time, network/station/location_code.

Iterations so far:
- Turns 4-9: PhaseNet-scedc, then +stead ensemble with thresholds 0.3→0.15→0.10. Coverage: 65/100 files, 230 picks (117 P, 113 S).
- Turn 15: On BG.ACR..DP.0215954.npz PhaseNet_N=1.0, P_max=0.10, S_max=0.032 → data too quiet even after ×1e10.

Current chunk (Turns 16–30):
- Turn 16: Bandpass 2–20 Hz filter test on ACR file dramatically improves detection: P_max 0.10→0.581.
- Turn 17-18: Added detrend+taper+bandpass 2–20 Hz preprocessing in load_stream. Rerun: 249 picks (134 P, 115 S) over 67 files.
- Turn 19-20: Added EQTransformer-scedc to ensemble (now PhaseNet-scedc, PhaseNet-stead, EQTransformer-scedc). Result: 309 picks (169 P, 140 S) over 67 files. Picks/file: many with 3-7 → likely low precision.
- Turn 21-22: Added voting logic — require agreement from ≥2 distinct models per cluster. Result: 128 picks (67 P, 61 S) over 62 files. Precision-focused but recall dropped.
- Turn 23-24: Tiered acceptance: accept if votes≥2 OR single-model prob≥0.5. Result: 171 picks (94 P, 77 S) over 65 files.
- Turn 25-26: Distribution analysis: P median idx≈5995, S median≈6235. P-S gap median 272 samples (2.72 s), p75=2238 (concerning — some P picks likely spurious/very early). 52 files have both P&S; 7 P-only; 6 S-only. Some files show two P picks with one very early (e.g. 408, 1892) suggesting false positives outside event window.
- Turn 27-28: Added physics/window priors: EVENT_WIN=(3000,9000), MIN_SP_GAP=20, MAX_SP_GAP=800; keep single best S per file, single best P constrained to be MIN_SP_GAP–MAX_SP_GAP before S (or single high-confidence P if no S). Result: 110 picks (53 P, 57 S) over 63 files, exactly one pick per (file,phase). Recall dropped noticeably from 94P/77S → 53P/57S; the window/gap constraints may be discarding legitimate picks (especially P candidates that are >800 samples before S at large distances, or picks near edges of EVENT_WIN).
- Turn 29-30: Loosened thresholds — P_THR/S_THR 0.1→0.05, single-model acceptance prob 0.5→0.4. Not yet run.

Current state: pick.py uses 3-model ensemble (PhaseNet-scedc, PhaseNet-stead, EQTransformer-scedc), bandpass 2–20 Hz preprocessing, model thresholds 0.05, cluster tolerance 10 samples, EVENT_WIN=(3000,9000), S-P gap 20–800 samples, tiered acceptance (votes≥2 OR prob≥0.4), keeps single best P and single best S per file with S-anchored P selection. Latest measured results before this round's loosening: 110 picks over 63 files. Awaiting rerun with looser 0.05/0.4 settings. No F1 ground-truth check has been done. No terminal/infeasible signal emitted.

Open concerns going forward: (1) recall drop after physics priors — MAX_SP_GAP=800 may be too tight for distant events; (2) 35+ files still yield no picks (very-low-amplitude / low-SNR traces) — may need further scaling or model choice for those; (3) constraint "keep only single best P/S" may hurt if task actually rewards multiple correct picks per file (task allows >1 pick per phase per file); (4) no direct measurement of pick quality has been performed.
</summary>
